basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old gamer and tech enthusiast from Devon, UK. I've recently started exploring the world of Reddit to connect with fellow gamers and to learn more about various hobbies. I work as a junior IT technician during the day and spend my evenings gaming or engaging with online communities. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my weekends mountain biking and building trails. I'm usually online during late evenings, around 9 PM to midnight GMT.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong interest in gaming and technology, mostly self-taught through years of playing and tinkering with hardware. I have some formal education in IT, which has helped me secure my current job. I also have a passion for outdoor activities, which I've been pursuing since moving to the countryside.
